scope.response: data32 proton only 10mmAl; NOT full38 GCR+SEP 3g/cm2

hold_candidates.comparison_status: bin-labelled opportunity only, not a sufficient controller exit test
required_conditions: legal LOW under E at an actual window phase
last alarm plus h elapsed; no subsequent reset

pair_distribution_scope: T67 analysis-window union; complete T72 approaches including background are in interval_envelopes.csv and crossings.csv.gz

candidate_classes.entry_scope: new entry and every repeat after any possible causal exit
candidate_classes.held_scope: only intervals with separately proved uninterrupted FAST
candidate_classes.continuous_condition: H_L(lambda) absolutely continuous; H_L(lambda(t2))-H_L(lambda(t1)) <= integral_[t1,t2] rho(u) du for every t1<t2; rho_held only on proved uninterrupted FAST, rho_entry elsewhere

conservative_conditional_fallback.entry_scope: new entry and every repeat after any possible causal exit
conservative_conditional_fallback.held_scope: only intervals with separately proved uninterrupted FAST
conservative_conditional_fallback.continuous_condition: H_L(lambda) absolutely continuous; H_L(lambda(t2))-H_L(lambda(t1)) <= integral_[t1,t2] rho(u) du for every t1<t2; rho_held only on proved uninterrupted FAST, rho_entry elsewhere
conservative_conditional_fallback.reason: No uncertain interval is exempted from the entry cone by a catalogue label. Slow candidates require a separately proved causal held-state partition.
conservative_conditional_fallback.status: retains the old conditional cone; not a new physical or future-coverage certificate

illustrative_margin.formula: rho_design = factor * measured_max_H; separate per cadence/model/mask/level/stratum
illustrative_margin.status: design sensitivity only, no statistical or physical coverage

do_not_infer: lambda low means zero ERR or LOW
oracle-U counts follow the E service law
bin extrema bound within-bin or future growth
strict selection proves absence of excluded fast fronts

missing_transfer.spectral_response: energy/angular time series transfer from data32/proton/10mmAl to full38/background+SEP/3 and 2.5g/cm2
missing_transfer.continuous_growth: bound on all within-bin pairs, not selected interpolation; include future coverage/exceptions
missing_transfer.ERR_E: read/conditional-repair E calendar and phase, full38 grouping, pending corrections, detection/delivery law and reset/hold history
missing_transfer.early_LOW: counts in actual 40/60s windows and program/delivery delay; 60/300s means do not identify them
